methods.name: convertInteger
methods.docu:
Return an Integer that represents the value of the string, or the default value upon conversion error.

Parameters:

  • value The string to convert.
  • defaultValue The default value to return upon conversion error.

Returns: The integer resulting from the conversion, or the default value if the conversion could not occur.

methods.name: convertBoolean
methods.docu:
Return a Boolean that is 'true' if any string containing "true", "t", "yes", "y", or "1" is passed in (case insensitive), 'false' if any string containing "false", "f", "no", "n" or "0" is passed in, or the default boolean otherwise. Note: This is significantly more lenient then the generic functionality provided by the java.lang.Boolean parsing operation.

Parameters:

  • value The value to convert.
  • defaultValue The default value to return upon conversion error.

Returns: The converted boolean, or the default value if conversion failed.

methods.name: convertDate
methods.docu:
Return a Date that represents the value of the string using the given pattern, or the default upon conversion error.

Parameters:

  • value The string to convert.
  • pattern The pattern to use when converting the date, which should match one of the patterns available via the java.text.SimpleDateFormat class.
  • defaultValue The default value to return upon conversion error.

Returns: The date resulting from the conversion, or the default value if the conversion could not occur.

classes.name: DOMUtil
classes.docu: A utility class for parsing and preparing XML documents

methods.name: getValue
methods.docu:
This method returns the value of a node.

Parameters:

  • p_xmlNode XML Node to get the value for.

Returns: String containing the value of the Node

methods.name: getStringValue
methods.docu:
Returns the value of the given sub-element as a String. Returns the default value if the sub-element wasn't found or the value was empty.

Parameters:

  • p_parent the parent element where the child is found in the DOM tree
  • p_name the name of the DOM node that where the value resides.
  • p_defaultValue the default value returned is the node wasn't found or value was empty

methods.name: getBooleanValue
methods.docu:
Returns the value of the given sub-element as a boolean. Returns the default value if the sub-element wasn't found or the value was empty.

Parameters:

  • p_parent the parent element where the child is found in the DOM tree
  • p_name the name of the DOM node that where the value resides.
  • p_defaultVal the default value returned is the node wasn't found

methods.name: getIntValue
methods.docu:
Returns the value of the given sub-element as an int. Returns the default value if the sub-element wasn't found or the value was empty.

Parameters:

  • p_parent the parent element where the child is found in the DOM tree
  • p_name the name of the DOM node that where the value resides.
  • p_defaultVal the default value returned is the node wasn't found

methods.name: getValue
methods.docu:
Returns a value from either an attribute or a sub-node in the Element. Extract from XML in either of these formats: or value

Parameters:

  • p_element The enclosing element for the value we're interested in
  • p_string The name of the attribute / sub-node

Returns: String

methods.name: getValueArray
methods.docu:
Returns a List of Strings for repeating nodes in the Element Example XML: parent childchild1/child childchild2/child /parent

Parameters:

  • p_element
  • p_string

Returns: List

methods.name: removeChild
methods.docu:
Removes all instances of node-name from the parent Element

Parameters:

  • p_element the parent
  • p_string the name of children to remove

methods.name: hasChild
methods.docu:
Returns whether or not a child node with the given name is present in the parent Element

Parameters:

  • p_element the parent
  • p_name the name of the child to check for

Returns: boolean Wether or not the child exists in the parent element

methods.name: cleanupNode
methods.docu:
Recursively removes all empty Text nodes from the specified Node

Parameters:

  • p_node the parent node

methods.name: removeChildren
methods.docu:
Removes ALL child elements from the specified parent node.

Parameters:

  • p_node the parent node

methods.name: setTextNode
methods.docu:
Adds or changes the specified child-node to contain a single Text value in the format node-name>node-value/node-name>

Parameters:

  • p_parent the parent node
  • p_nodeName the node name
  • p_nodeValue the node value
